label.purpose: Counts, metadata, and compact state labels.

shadows.name: panel-ambient
shadows.purpose: Structural panel depth only; never applied to an interactive control.

motion.name: reduced-transparency
motion.purpose: The mandatory fallback for glass material.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: One clear action in a focused region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.583 0.105 177.1); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font: 500 14px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(15 143 122 / .45); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Structural Panel
components.description: A container that groups a task without turning every child into a card.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 16px; border-radius: 24px; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font: 600 15px system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Content Mode Selector
components.description: A compact file/text choice after a target device has been selected.
components.css: .ds-mode { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 12px; background: oklch(.97 0 0); } .ds-mode button { min-height: 36px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 12px; background: transparent; color: oklch(.205 0 0); } .ds-mode button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(.145 0 0); }

narrative.overview: A quiet, technically honest instrument for moving information between trusted devices. Structural clarity and truthful state outrank decoration; each target adapts the material to its platform without changing the product’s visual language.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Harbor Teal is the sole brand accent; semantic colors are not decoration.

rules.name: The State Ink Rule
rules.body: Use state ink tokens for readable status text on light or tinted surfaces.

rules.name: The Flat-Control, Glass-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Depth belongs to structural containers, never to controls users click or type into.

dos: Do preserve semantic tokens across every target.
Do show truthful trust, connection, and delivery state.
donts: Don't create a target-specific visual world.
Don't make send or Outbox a permanent navigation destination.
